        self._text_filters = [dict(t) for t in (existing or {}).get('text_filters', [])]
        self._sort_levels  = [dict(s) for s in (existing or {}).get('sort', [])]
        _tf = (existing or {}).get('type_filter')
        self._initial_types = set(_tf['types']) if _tf else set()

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        name_row = QHBoxLayout()
        name_row.addWidget(QLabel("Name:"))
        self.name_edit = QLineEdit(existing['name'] if existing else '')
        name_row.addWidget(self.name_edit, 1)
        layout.addLayout(name_row)

        # ── Time & Date ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        date_box = QGroupBox("Time && Date")
        date_v = QVBoxLayout(date_box)
        self.date_list = QListWidget()
        self.date_list.setMaximumHeight(90)
        date_v.addWidget(self.date_list)
        date_add_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.date_col_combo = QComboBox()
        self.date_col_combo.addItems(self._date_headers)
        self.date_from = QDateEdit(QDate(2000, 1, 1))
        self.date_to   = QDateEdit(QDate.currentDate())
        for de in (self.date_from, self.date_to):
            de.setDisplayFormat("yyyy-MM-dd")
            de.setCalendarPopup(True)
        date_add_row.addWidget(self.date_col_combo)
        date_add_row.addWidget(self.date_from)
        date_add_row.addWidget(QLabel("–"))
        date_add_row.addWidget(self.date_to)
        date_add_btn = QPushButton("Add")
        date_add_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_add_date)
        date_add_row.addWidget(date_add_btn)
        date_rm_btn = QPushButton("Remove Selected")
        date_rm_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_remove_date)
        date_add_row.addWidget(date_rm_btn)
        date_v.addLayout(date_add_row)
        layout.addWidget(date_box)

        # ── File Type ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        type_box = QGroupBox("File Type")
        type_v = QVBoxLayout(type_box)
        self.type_list = QListWidget()
        self.type_list.setMaximumHeight(110)
        for v in sorted(type_values):
            item = QListWidgetItem(v)
            item.setFlags(item.flags() | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
            item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked if v in self._initial_types
                               else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
            self.type_list.addItem(item)
        type_v.addWidget(self.type_list)
        type_btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        type_all_btn = QPushButton("Select All")
        type_all_btn.clicked.connect(partial(self._set_all_type_checks, True))
        type_none_btn = QPushButton("Select None")
        type_none_btn.clicked.connect(partial(self._set_all_type_checks, False))
        type_btn_row.addWidget(type_all_btn)
        type_btn_row.addWidget(type_none_btn)
        type_btn_row.addStretch()
        type_v.addLayout(type_btn_row)
        layout.addWidget(type_box)

        # ── Other Columns ────────────────────────────────────────────
        other_box = QGroupBox("Other Columns")
        other_v = QVBoxLayout(other_box)
        self.text_list = QListWidget()
        self.text_list.setMaximumHeight(90)
        other_v.addWidget(self.text_list)
        other_add_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.text_col_combo = QComboBox()
        self.text_col_combo.addItems(self._other_headers)
        self.text_mode_combo = QComboBox()
        for value, label in self._MODE_LABELS:
            self.text_mode_combo.addItem(label, value)
        self.text_value_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.text_value_edit.setPlaceholderText(
            "Value — comma-separated for \"matches any of\"")
        other_add_row.addWidget(self.text_col_combo)
        other_add_row.addWidget(self.text_mode_combo)
        other_add_row.addWidget(self.text_value_edit, 1)
        text_add_btn = QPushButton("Add")
        text_add_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_add_text)
        other_add_row.addWidget(text_add_btn)
        other_v.addLayout(other_add_row)
        text_rm_btn = QPushButton("Remove Selected")
        text_rm_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_remove_text)
        other_v.addWidget(text_rm_btn)
        layout.addWidget(other_box)

        # ── Sort ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        sort_box = QGroupBox("Sort")
        sort_v = QVBoxLayout(sort_box)
        self.sort_list = QListWidget()
        self.sort_list.setMaximumHeight(90)
        sort_v.addWidget(self.sort_list)
        sort_add_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.sort_col_combo = QComboBox()
        self.sort_col_combo.addItems(self._headers)
        self.sort_dir_combo = QComboBox()
        self.sort_dir_combo.addItem("Ascending", False)
        self.sort_dir_combo.addItem("Descending", True)
        sort_add_row.addWidget(self.sort_col_combo)
        sort_add_row.addWidget(self.sort_dir_combo)
        sort_add_btn = QPushButton("Add Level")
        sort_add_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_add_sort)
        sort_add_row.addWidget(sort_add_btn)
        sort_v.addLayout(sort_add_row)
        sort_btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        sort_up_btn = QPushButton("Move Up")
        sort_up_btn.clicked.connect(partial(self._move_sort, -1))
        sort_down_btn = QPushButton("Move Down")
        sort_down_btn.clicked.connect(partial(self._move_sort, 1))
        sort_rm_btn = QPushButton("Remove Selected")
        sort_rm_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_remove_sort)
        sort_btn_row.addWidget(sort_up_btn)
        sort_btn_row.addWidget(sort_down_btn)
        sort_btn_row.addWidget(sort_rm_btn)
        sort_btn_row.addStretch()
        sort_v.addLayout(sort_btn_row)
        layout.addWidget(sort_box)

        self._refresh_date_list()
        self._refresh_text_list()
        self._refresh_sort_list()

        # ── Save / Cancel / Delete ───────────────────────────────────
        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.delete_btn = QPushButton("Delete Preset")
        self.delete_btn.setVisible(existing is not None)
        self.delete_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_delete)
        btn_row.addWidget(self.delete_btn)
        btn_row.addStretch()
        save_btn = QPushButton("Save")
        save_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_save)
        cancel_btn = QPushButton("Cancel")
        cancel_btn.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        btn_row.addWidget(save_btn)
        btn_row.addWidget(cancel_btn)
        layout.addLayout(btn_row)

    # ── Time & Date ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _refresh_date_list(self):
        self.date_list.clear()
        for d in self._date_filters:
            self.date_list.addItem(f"{d['column']}: {d['from']} → {d['to']}")

    def _on_add_date(self):
        if not self._date_headers:
            return
        self._date_filters.append({
            'column': self.date_col_combo.currentText(),
            'from': self.date_from.date().toString('yyyy-MM-dd'),
            'to': self.date_to.date().toString('yyyy-MM-dd'),
        })
        self._refresh_date_list()

    def _on_remove_date(self):
        row = self.date_list.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            del self._date_filters[row]
            self._refresh_date_list()

    # ── File Type ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _set_all_type_checks(self, checked: bool):
        state = Qt.CheckState.Checked if checked else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
        for i in range(self.type_list.count()):
            self.type_list.item(i).setCheckState(state)

    def _checked_types(self) -> list:
        return [self.type_list.item(i).text() for i in range(self.type_list.count())
               if self.type_list.item(i).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked]

    # ── Other Columns ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _refresh_text_list(self):
        self.text_list.clear()
        labels = dict(self._MODE_LABELS)
        for t in self._text_filters:
            cols = '/'.join(t['columns'])
            vals = ', '.join(t['values'])
            self.text_list.addItem(
                f"{cols} {labels.get(t['mode'], t['mode']).lower()} \"{vals}\"")

    def _on_add_text(self):
        if not self._other_headers:
            return
        raw = self.text_value_edit.text().strip()
        values = [v.strip() for v in raw.split(',') if v.strip()]
        if not values:
            return
        self._text_filters.append({
            'columns': [self.text_col_combo.currentText()],
            'mode': self.text_mode_combo.currentData(),
            'values': values,
        })
        self.text_value_edit.clear()
        self._refresh_text_list()

    def _on_remove_text(self):
        row = self.text_list.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            del self._text_filters[row]
            self._refresh_text_list()

    # ── Sort ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _refresh_sort_list(self):
        self.sort_list.clear()
        for s in self._sort_levels:
            arrow = '↓' if s['descending'] else '↑'
            self.sort_list.addItem(f"{s['column']} {arrow}")

    def _on_add_sort(self):
        if not self._headers:
            return
        self._sort_levels.append({
            'column': self.sort_col_combo.currentText(),
            'descending': bool(self.sort_dir_combo.currentData()),
        })
        self._refresh_sort_list()

    def _on_remove_sort(self):
        row = self.sort_list.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            del self._sort_levels[row]
            self._refresh_sort_list()

    def _move_sort(self, delta: int):
        row = self.sort_list.currentRow()
        new_row = row + delta
        if row < 0 or not (0 <= new_row < len(self._sort_levels)):
            return
        self._sort_levels[row], self._sort_levels[new_row] = \
            self._sort_levels[new_row], self._sort_levels[row]
        self._refresh_sort_list()
        self.sort_list.setCurrentRow(new_row)

    # ── Save / Delete ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _on_delete(self):
        if QMessageBox.question(
                self, "Delete Preset",
                "Delete this preset? This cannot be undone.",
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.No) != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        self._deleted = True
        self.accept()

    def _on_save(self):
        if not self.name_edit.text().strip():
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Name Required", "Enter a name for this preset.")
            return
        self._deleted = False
        self.accept()

    def was_deleted(self) -> bool:
        return self._deleted

    def result_preset(self) -> dict:
        """Call after exec() returns Accepted and was_deleted() is False."""
        checked = self._checked_types()
        return {
            'name': self.name_edit.text().strip(),
            'date_filters': list(self._date_filters),
            'type_filter': {'types': checked} if checked else None,
            'text_filters': list(self._text_filters),
            'sort': list(self._sort_levels),
        }


class ProcessDialog(QDialog):
    """Lets the user view header-scan history and re-run the file header scan."""
    header_scan_done       = Signal(dict)
    header_scan_tier_done  = Signal(int)   # emitted ONLY for an actual tier upgrade run — see _on_header_done
    header_types_cleared   = Signal()   # emitted before a rescan so the main window can reset
    nested_extraction_done = Signal()   # emitted after NestedArchiveWorker finishes
    embedded_media_scan_done = Signal()   # emitted after EmbeddedMediaScanWorker finishes
    media_metadata_scan_done = Signal()   # emitted after MediaMetadataScanWorker finishes
    leveldb_indexing_started = Signal()   # emitted right before the LevelDB indexing stage starts
    leveldb_indexing_done    = Signal()   # emitted once it finishes (or is skipped as "nothing to do")

    _RUN_TYPE           = 'header_scan'
    _RUN_TYPE_INTEGRITY = 'integrity_check'

    def __init__(self, zip_path, case_dir, ffs_adapter, ui_metadata,
                 delta=None, preselect_nested=False,
                 auto_archive_selection=False,
                 preselect_tier1=False, preselect_embedded_media=False,
                 is_android=False, guid_to_bundle=None, folder_map=None,
                 local_media_metadata_candidates_fn=None,
                 leveldb_coverage_fn=None, leveldb_index_fn=None,
                 parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        # Both callables only — FastZipBrowser owns the real engine
        # (_leveldb_search_coverage/_index_leveldb_folders_batched)
        # since the indexing pass deliberately shares the GUI's own zip
        # reader rather than opening an independent one (see
        # _index_leveldb_folders_batched's own docstring for why — it's
        # the one Process Case stage that genuinely can't be a
        # standalone QThread worker the way every other stage here is).
        # Moved into an explicit, checked-by-default stage 2026-10-12,
        # direct request: "the leveldb processing that is do[ne] is
        # started after the data is loaded into the gui and at the same
        # time that the process dialog opens[;] can we instead have it
        # as an option in the process case and have [it] ticked on...
        # like media data processing."
        self._leveldb_coverage_fn = leveldb_coverage_fn
        self._leveldb_index_fn = leveldb_index_fn
        self._leveldb_indexing_active = False
        # Callable (not a plain list) — [(ui_path, bytes_or_local_path,
        # ext)] for nested-archive/embedded-media files needs to be
        # computed FRESH right before the media-metadata stage actually
        # starts, not once at dialog-open time: THIS SAME run may have
        # just found new embedded-media hits a moment earlier (the
        # previous stage in this exact chain), and a list captured
        # before that would miss them. FastZipBrowser (the only place
        # that owns _nested_archive_map/_embedded_media_containers) is
        # the only one that can build this, so it hands over a callable
        # rather than a value — see MediaMetadataScanWorker's own
        # docstring and _start_media_metadata_scan below.
        self._local_media_metadata_candidates_fn = local_media_metadata_candidates_fn
        self._media_metadata_worker: MediaMetadataScanWorker | None = None
        # Needed to canonicalize a candidate's GUID → bundle id before
        # checking it against embedded_media_skip_list.py's own entries
        # — see FfsAdapter.canonical_app_path()'s docstring, added
        # 2026-10-10 as a real fix for bundle-id-scoped entries that
        # never matched anything before this.
        self._guid_to_bundle = guid_to_bundle or {}
        self._folder_map     = folder_map
        # preselect_tier1/preselect_embedded_media (added 2026-09-26) are
        # for FastZipBrowser._open_process_dialog_for_new_case — the
        # first-load flow that hands off from the Timestamp Display
        # dialog straight to here with sensible defaults pre-ticked
        # (never auto-run — see that method's own docstring for why).
        # Which platform's own embedded-media skip list applies to this
        # case — see embedded_media_skip_list.py's own "one list per
        # platform" entry, 2026-09-24.
        self._skip_list_platform = 'android' if is_android else 'ios'
        self.setWindowTitle("Process Case")
        self.setModal(True)
        # Widened/heightened 2026-09-22 to accommodate the embedded-media
        # controls (checkbox + scope radios + coverage label) added the
        # same day, and the longer per-file progress line that scan emits
        # (e.g. "Embedded-media sweep: 1,487 / 1,490 — map_cache.db —
        # found so far: 1,552 picture(s), 0 video(s)") — the previous
        # 620px width wrapped that onto multiple lines, and the dialog
        # had no reserved height for the new controls beyond auto-sizing.
        self.setMinimumSize(820, 640)
        self._zip_path        = zip_path
        self._case_dir        = case_dir
        self._adapter         = ffs_adapter
        self._ui_metadata     = ui_metadata
        self._delta           = delta
        self._candidate_count      = 0   # recomputed once an upgrade tier is actually picked
        self._pending_upgrade_tier = 0   # set by _run_operations right before a scan actually starts
        self._scan_worker:      HeaderScanWorker     | None = None
        self._nested_worker:    NestedArchiveWorker  | None = None
        self._integrity_worker: IntegrityCheckWorker | None = None
        self._embedded_media_worker: EmbeddedMediaScanWorker | None = None

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        layout.addWidget(QLabel(f"<b>Archive:</b> {os.path.basename(zip_path)}"))

        # Case folder row
        case_row = QHBoxLayout()
        case_row.addWidget(QLabel("Case folder:"))
        self._case_edit = QLineEdit(case_dir or "")
        self._case_edit.setReadOnly(True)
        case_row.addWidget(self._case_edit, 1)
        browse_btn = QPushButton("Browse…")
        browse_btn.setFixedWidth(80)
        browse_btn.clicked.connect(self._browse_case)
        case_row.addWidget(browse_btn)
        layout.addLayout(case_row)

        self._chk_integrity = QCheckBox("Check data integrity")
        self._chk_integrity.setToolTip(
            "Computes the SHA256 of the FFS zip and compares it against the "
            "value recorded at capture\n(the .ufd file for Cellebrite, the "
            ".pdf report for GrayKey, next to the zip).\n"
            "A mismatch means the data has changed since acquisition.")
        # Ticked by default for a fresh case; once a check is on record it
        # starts unticked so a huge zip isn't re-hashed on every Run.
        self._chk_integrity.setChecked(
            self._load_last_integrity_run() is None)
        layout.addWidget(self._chk_integrity)

        integrity_row = QHBoxLayout()
        integrity_row.setContentsMargins(22, 0, 0, 0)   # align under checkbox text
        self._integrity_label = QLabel()
        self._integrity_label.setWordWrap(True)
        integrity_row.addWidget(self._integrity_label, 1)
        self._integrity_hist_btn = QPushButton("Full History…")
        self._integrity_hist_btn.clicked.connect(self._show_integrity_history)
        integrity_row.addWidget(self._integrity_hist_btn)
        layout.addLayout(integrity_row)

        layout.addWidget(QLabel("<hr><b>Operations</b>"))

        # Header scan: UPGRADE-ONLY — no downgrade and no re-running an
        # already-done tier (a fresh case may genuinely sit at Tier 0,
        # never scanned at all — case creation no longer auto-runs a scan
        # of its own; this dialog is opened pre-ticked to Tier 1 instead,
        # see FastZipBrowser._open_process_dialog_for_new_case — so Tier 0
        # is an ordinary starting state here, not just a legacy-case
        # edge case). See TODO.md item 20.
        layout.addWidget(QLabel("<b>Header scan</b>"))
        header_status_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self._header_status_label = QLabel()
        self._header_status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        header_status_row.addWidget(self._header_status_label, 1)
        scan_folders_btn = QPushButton("Scanned Folders…")
        scan_folders_btn.setToolTip(
            "Show which folders Tier 1/2 restrict to — files outside these "
            "keep their plain extension-based type unless Tier 3 is used.")
        scan_folders_btn.clicked.connect(self._show_scan_folders)
        header_status_row.addWidget(scan_folders_btn)
        layout.addLayout(header_status_row)

        # A real QButtonGroup/QRadioButton set — added 2026-09-26, direct
        # request: "the process case dialog should have a radiobutton
        # group for the 3 tiers and default to tier 1 if not already
        # run[;] a user can then decide to upgrade." Previously this was
        # a set of manually-exclusive QCheckBoxes with NO default
        # selection, per a real Qt quirk found and worked around at the
        # time: an exclusive-group radio button couldn't be reliably
        # programmatically unchecked back to "nothing selected" from
        # within its own click handler (confirmed by direct testing —
        # QButtonGroup.checkedId() kept reporting the just-clicked id
        # regardless, even deferred via QTimer.singleShot). That quirk
        # only mattered because the old design needed a genuine "nothing
        # chosen yet" state; this new design never does — there is
        # ALWAYS a default selection (the lowest tier not yet run, Tier 1
        # for a fresh case), so a real radio group works cleanly:
        # switching the checked button to a DIFFERENT valid tier (as
        # opposed to unchecking to nothing) is a normal, reliable
        # QButtonGroup operation. All three tiers are always shown, not
        # just the remaining upgrades — one already run is disabled and
        # labeled "(already run)" for context, rather than disappearing,
        # so the group reads as the case's whole progression at a glance.
        self._tier_radios_container = QVBoxLayout()
        layout.addLayout(self._tier_radios_container)
        self._tier_button_group = QButtonGroup(self)
        self._tier_button_group.setExclusive(True)
        self._tier_radios: dict[int, QRadioButton] = {}
        self._selected_upgrade_tier = 0
        self._current_tier = 0
        self._rebuild_tier_upgrade_ui()

        self._chk_nested = QCheckBox("Find and select archives for extraction")
        self._chk_nested.setChecked(False)
        self._chk_nested.setToolTip(
            "Scans app containers, iCloud/Files, Mail and SMS locations for archive "
            "files,\nthen shows a selection dialog so you can choose which to extract.\n"
            "Extensionless archives are already covered by this case's own "
            "header scan (at least Tier 1 always runs at case creation).")
        layout.addWidget(self._chk_nested)

        # Embedded-media sweep (added 2026-09-22, see app/embedded_media_scan.py
        # and CLAUDE.md's own "Embedded-media sweep" Conventions entry).
        # Placed here, right after archive extraction, and run LAST in the
        # operation chain (_continue_after_nested) per direct instruction —
        # so a database or plist that only existed inside a nested archive
        # just extracted above is already visible to this scan by the time
        # it runs, never missed because it ran first.
        self._chk_embedded_media = QCheckBox(
            "Scan databases and property lists for embedded media")
        self._chk_embedded_media.setChecked(False)
        self._chk_embedded_media.setToolTip(
            "Finds image/video content embedded inside SQLite BLOB cells and "
            "plist NSData values, across every SQLite database and plist file "
            "in the archive (or just app/user-accessible areas, per the scope "
            "below) — including content recovered from freed pages, in-page "
            "freeblocks, and WAL history, not just what's currently live.\n"
            "Runs AFTER archive extraction above, so a database or plist that "
            "only existed inside a nested archive is included too.")
        layout.addWidget(self._chk_embedded_media)

        embedded_scope_row = QHBoxLayout()
        embedded_scope_row.setContentsMargins(22, 0, 0, 0)
        self._embedded_scope_group = QButtonGroup(self)
        self._rb_embedded_scope_app = QRadioButton("App/user-accessible areas only")
        self._rb_embedded_scope_all = QRadioButton("Everywhere (exhaustive)")
        self._rb_embedded_scope_app.setChecked(True)
        self._embedded_scope_group.addButton(self._rb_embedded_scope_app, 0)
        self._embedded_scope_group.addButton(self._rb_embedded_scope_all, 1)
        embedded_scope_row.addWidget(self._rb_embedded_scope_app)
        embedded_scope_row.addWidget(self._rb_embedded_scope_all)
        embedded_scope_row.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(embedded_scope_row)

        self._embedded_scope_label = QLabel()
        self._embedded_scope_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._embedded_scope_label.setStyleSheet("color: grey; padding-left: 22px;")
        layout.addWidget(self._embedded_scope_label)

        # Known-noise skip list — added 2026-09-24, direct request: "we
        # are reviewing some big db and it can take a while to check
        # them but there are some db that either have no media file and
        # are unlikely to ever have any... [or] will never be of use...
        # i would like a list of sqlite db that are not worth looking
        # at." See app/embedded_media_skip_list.py for the store itself
        # (a global, hand-editable list — an examiner builds it up over
        # time from real casework, it's never auto-populated). Checked
        # by default since the whole point is to save time on a database
        # already confirmed not worth scanning.
        embedded_skip_row = QHBoxLayout()
        embedded_skip_row.setContentsMargins(22, 0, 0, 0)
        self._chk_embedded_media_skip_list = QCheckBox(
            "Skip databases/property lists on the known-noise list")
        self._chk_embedded_media_skip_list.setChecked(True)
        self._chk_embedded_media_skip_list.setToolTip(
            "Excludes any file matching an entry you've added to the "
            "known-noise list — a database confirmed to either hold no "
            "embedded media at all, or only ever app/UI graphics (icons, "
            "launcher art) with no evidentiary value. Uncheck to scan "
            "everything regardless of this list.")
        embedded_skip_row.addWidget(self._chk_embedded_media_skip_list)
        self._embedded_skip_list_btn = QPushButton("View/Edit List…")
        self._embedded_skip_list_btn.clicked.connect(self._show_embedded_media_skip_list_dialog)
        embedded_skip_row.addWidget(self._embedded_skip_list_btn)
        embedded_skip_row.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(embedded_skip_row)

        for rb in (self._rb_embedded_scope_app, self._rb_embedded_scope_all):
            rb.toggled.connect(self._update_embedded_scope_label)
        self._chk_embedded_media.toggled.connect(self._on_embedded_media_toggled)
        self._on_embedded_media_toggled(False)   # scope controls start hidden

        # LevelDB/IndexedDB indexing for Keyword Search — moved
        # 2026-10-12 from an automatic QTimer.singleShot fired right
        # after case load into this explicit, checked-by-default stage
        # — direct request: "the leveldb processing that is do[ne] is
        # started after the data is loaded into the gui and at the same
        # time that the process dialog opens[;] can we instead have it
        # as an option in the process case and have [it] ticked on...
        # like media [meta]data processing." It used to race the
        # Process Case dialog opening for a brand-new case, competing
        # for the same CPU/UI thread as whatever the examiner just
        # asked that dialog to do. Runs FIRST among the new/moved
        # stages (before the header scan) — unlike media metadata,
        # nothing else in this chain needs it to have run first, and it
        # doesn't need anything else to have run first either.
        self._chk_leveldb = QCheckBox(
            "Index LevelDB/IndexedDB folders for Keyword Search")
        self._chk_leveldb.setChecked(True)
        self._chk_leveldb.setToolTip(
            "Indexes every LevelDB/IndexedDB folder (Chrome/WebKit local "
            "storage, app caches, etc.) not already covered so Keyword "
            "Search can find records inside them. Unticking this just "
            "means Keyword Search runs with whatever coverage this case "
            "already has — run it again later from here at any time.")
        layout.addWidget(self._chk_leveldb)

        # Media metadata (EXIF / video info) — added 2026-10-11, direct
        # request: "i kind of think i should just do a media pass after
        # the header check via type i.e. pic[t]ure, png and video[,] get
        # all the exif and add it as ad[d]itional columns in the
        # browser." Runs LAST (after header scan, nested-archive
        # extraction, and the embedded-media sweep above — "for the zips
        # and embe[d]ded it should be done as part of the process like
        # the header review"), scoped the SAME in-scope-for-processing
        # way the header scan already is (see
        # _collect_media_metadata_candidates — direct correction: "we
        # are only doing this in the [folders] that are marked as place
        # to include"). Checked by default — direct instruction ("lets
        # make it that it is a[u]tomat[ic]ly tick[ed] but the user can
        # untick it if they want") — real cost confirmed low (benchmarked
        # against real archive data before shipping this: ~0.6ms/image,
        # ~12ms/video, and a lazy zip-slice reader so a large video's
        # metadata read touches only the bytes it actually needs, not
        # the whole file).
        self._chk_media_metadata = QCheckBox(
            "Extract media metadata (EXIF / video info) into new File Browser columns")
        self._chk_media_metadata.setChecked(True)
        self._chk_media_metadata.setToolTip(

            "already-extracted nested-archive and embedded-media files. "
            "Shown as new \"(EXIF)\" columns in the File Browser.")
        layout.addWidget(self._chk_media_metadata)

        # Stats block
        self._stats_label = QLabel()
        self._stats_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self._stats_label)

        # Progress / status. Word-wrap added 2026-09-22 alongside the
        # wider/taller dialog above — the embedded-media scan's own
        # per-file progress line (file name + running picture/video
        # tally) routinely runs longer than a single line comfortably
        # fits, and this label previously had no wrap at all.
        self._status_label = QLabel()
        self._status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self._status_label)

        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_row.addStretch()
        self._run_btn = QPushButton("Run")
        self._run_btn.clicked.connect(self._run_operations)
        btn_row.addWidget(self._run_btn)
        self._cancel_btn = QPushButton("Cancel")
        self._cancel_btn.setVisible(False)

        btn_row.addWidget(self._cancel_btn)

        self._close_btn.clicked.connect(self.accept)
